test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some lamps are bulbs.

2) All bulbs are tubes.

3) Some tubes are pipes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bulbs are pipes.

II. At least some lamps are tubes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2189d6c9623c20318a37e47d68a00d60a163a587a8859801fe87e1459b99874.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bulbs are pipes → **Does not** **f**ollow (As all bulbs are tubes and some tubes are pipes. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. At least some lamps are tubes **→** Follow (As some lamps are bulbs and all bulbs are tubes. As whole bulbs comes in tubes and also have some part common with lamps, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
